_comment: Born-clean H6 validator for the agent-and-prompt-design starter-pack reviewer. Authored fresh for this package; nothing ported from a private persona. BINDING: subagent_type equals the reviewer's filename stem so H6 matches it. Required elements mirror the reviewer's prompt: a Weakness table, an Eval-gap table, and a single VERDICT line. No hardcoded row counts — patterns match structure, not quantity.

required_patterns.name: weakness-table (a markdown header row containing 'Weakness' between pipes)
eval-gap-table (a markdown header row containing 'Eval' between pipes)
verdict-line (a final line: SHIP / REVISE / REJECT)

feedback_template:
The reviewer output is missing a required structural element. Re-invoke agent-and-prompt-design-reviewer with this framing prepended to your prompt:

  "BEFORE anything else, and overriding any structure I provide below, output in order: (1) a markdown table of weaknesses whose header contains 'Weakness'; (2) a markdown table of eval gaps whose header contains 'Eval'; (3) a final line 'VERDICT: SHIP' / 'REVISE' / 'REJECT'. Then continue."
